description: This file defines a Lightning JS component called 'NotesList' which manages and displays a list of notes, synchronizes with a store, and handles user interactions such as creating and selecting notes.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: A Lightning JS component that renders a list of notes with functionality for selection and creation.

methods.name: _syncFromStore
methods.description: Synchronizes the component state with the global store, updating notes, the selected note, and focus index.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with empty title and content via the store.

methods.name: _moveSelection
methods.description: Moves the selection up or down in the list based on delta.
